sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Brings in route tools, audit and timeline services, database access and the symptom input formats.
sections.why: Needed to save entries, log them and add timeline events.

sections.name: SymptomsController (part 1)
sections.title: Logging a new symptom
sections.what: Saves a symptom for the signed-in user, defaulting to mild severity, and logs the creation.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond recording the diary entry.
sections.watch_out: The start time defaults to now when not given, so a symptom logged later than it began will look newer than it is.

sections.name: SymptomsController (part 2)
sections.title: Timeline entry and listing symptoms
sections.what: Adds a symptom event to the timeline. The list route returns the user's entries newest first, filtered by severity and date, with paging details.
sections.why: Likely reason: the timeline should show each symptom at the time it started.
sections.watch_out: The timeline event uses the start time, so back-dated symptoms appear in the past on the timeline.

sections.name: SymptomsController: if
sections.title: Filtering and paging the list
sections.what: Builds the search conditions from the optional filters, then runs the list and total count together and logs the view.
sections.why: Keeps the list fast and lets the app show page controls.
sections.watch_out: The filter object is loosely typed, so a new filter must be added carefully to avoid silently being ignored.

sections.name: SymptomsController (part 4)
sections.title: Resolving and deleting symptoms
sections.what: Resolve sets a resolved time on the user's own entry, logs it and adds a resolved event. Delete removes the entry and logs the deletion only when something was removed.
sections.why: Lets the user mark a symptom as over without losing the record of it.
sections.watch_out: Deletion is permanent here, so a removed symptom cannot be recovered from this code.

summary: Lets a signed-in user log, list, resolve and delete their own symptoms, and places each entry on the timeline.
purpose: Keeps a diary of symptoms with severity, triggers and timing.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The resolved state lets the diary show what is still ongoing.
how: Create saves the symptom, audits it and adds a timeline event. List returns the user's entries with filters and paging. Resolve checks ownership, sets a resolved time, audits and adds a resolved event. Delete removes the entry and audits it.
inputs: CreateSymptomDto and QuerySymptomsDto values, the entry id from the URL, and the user id from the token.
outputs: Objects with success and data, paging details for lists, or a not-found message.
risks: Delete removes the entry permanently, unlike the soft delete used for conditions and notes. Resolve does not stop an already resolved entry from being resolved again.
debug: If an entry will not delete, check it belongs to the signed-in user. If paging looks wrong, check page and limit values. If the timeline is missing events, check the timeline service.
